name: Recording-level splits of the ship detection datasets
notes: Image ids are the file stems written by the build scripts in src/data: data/<dataset>/images/<id>.jpg.
Keys are the protocol names of the code (--protocol); 'smd' is the zero-shot test set.
A recording is the unit kept in one subset; the recording-level bootstrap resamples the same units (McShips: photos).
random.cross_test = random test & session test: SeaShips test images that neither protocol trained on, where the leak of the random split is measured.
Check a rebuilt data/ against this file: python src/data/split_manifest.py check

session.recording: capture session: one camera's frames in time order, cut at gaps of more than 600 s (camera and time read from the on-screen display)
session.split_rule: whole sessions per subset; sizes as the random protocol, class proportions matched, passenger ship in every subset
session.source: SeaShips (Shao et al., IEEE Trans. Multimedia 2018), public 7,000-image subset as exported by Roboflow (Kaggle nam97595/seaships7k, 6,979 images)

random.split_rule: frame-level random split for comparison with published results: the uploader's test set, val drawn at random from its train set; adjacent frames of one session fall on both sides

smdplus.split_rule: the authors' video-level train / test split; five whole train videos form val; every 5th annotated frame
smdplus.source: SMD-Plus (Kim et al., J. Mar. Sci. Eng. 2022, 10, 377), relabelled VIS videos of the Singapore Maritime Dataset

aboships.recording: video (one trip; a frame every 15 s)
aboships.split_rule: whole days per subset: test 2018-06-26 and 06-29, val 06-28 and 07-06, train the other nine days
aboships.source: ABOships (Iancu et al., Remote Sens. 2021), Zenodo record 4736931, the 9,041 labelled frames

mcships.split_rule: the official ImageSets split; test_dedup leaves out 116 test photos with a near-copy in train (32x32 thumbnail cosine >= 0.98)

wsodd.recording: capture session: one camera's frames in time order, cut at gaps of more than 600 s; the untimed phone photos form one group
wsodd.split_rule: whole sessions per subset, about 70 / 10 / 20% of the frames, chosen for per-class box shares near those targets with every class in train and test

smd.split_rule: test only: every 5th annotated frame of the 40 annotated VIS videos, for zero-shot tests of SeaShips-trained detectors
smd.source: Singapore Maritime Dataset (Prasad et al., IEEE T-ITS 2017), Kaggle mmichelli/singapore-maritime-dataset
